services.name: Ghoul's Night
services.desc: Allan Paulose is a visual artist, curator, and co-founder of Art deCentrale, a creative space dedicated to representing and elevating under-recognized artists. His passion for visual arts began in elementary school, where he won several county-level competitions under the mentorship of his father, veteran artist K. J. Paulose. With a background in mechanical engineering, design, and business administration, Allan left his corporate career in analytics to pursue his lifelong passion for the arts. He has since collaborated with numerous artists across Northwest Arkansas and internationally, curating exhibitions and fostering creative connections within the community. Cory Rose Corbett, born
